function.name: select
function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  published_at,
  SEM_EXTRACT(
    content,
    dataset_name := 'name of the zoo location dataset or directory',
    scope := 'which United States zoo locations it includes',
    location_fields := 'available geographic fields such as state, city, latitude, and longitude',
    record_count := 'number of zoo or aquarium locations, number only',
    evidence := 'per_field'
  ) AS info
FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'United States zoos dataset latitude longitude CSV',
  'US zoo locations geocoded dataset download',
  'GitHub USA zoos latitude longitude csv',
  'data.gov zoo locations United States',
  'all zoos in America map coordinates directory',
  'OpenStreetMap United States zoos geodata download',
  'AZA accredited zoo list locations state directory',
  'Wikipedia list of zoos United States by state'
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(content, 'describes or contains a multi-location dataset or directory of zoos in the United States')","show_preview":false}

function.name: select
function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  published_at,
  SEM_EXTRACT(
    content,
    publisher := 'organization publishing the zoo directory',
    inclusion_rule := 'eligibility or inclusion rule for listed zoological facilities',
    facility_count := 'number of listed United States facilities, number only',
    has_addresses := 'whether individual facility addresses or cities and states are provided',
    evidence := 'per_field'
  ) AS info
FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'official Association of Zoos Aquariums accredited facilities United States list',
  'AZA find a zoo aquarium directory map United States',
  'Zoological Association of America accredited facilities directory USA',
  'American zoo association member directory locations',
  'USDA licensed zoo list United States facilities',
  'state by state zoo directory USA official',
  'accredited zoos by state United States 2026'
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(content, 'is an official or authoritative directory or list of zoological facilities with locations')","show_preview":false}

{"query":"SELECT
  regexp_extract(block, '<binding name=''item''>[\\s\\S]*?<uri>([^<]+)</uri>', 1) AS wikidata_url,
  regexp_extract(block, '<binding name=''itemLabel''>[\\s\\S]*?<literal[^>]*>([^<]+)</literal>', 1) AS zoo,
  regexp_extract(block, '<binding name=''stateLabel''>[\\s\\S]*?<literal[^>]*>([^<]+)</literal>', 1) AS state,
  TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(block, 'Point\\(([-0-9.]+) [-0-9.]+\\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS longitude,
  TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(block, 'Point\\([-0-9.]+ ([-0-9.]+)\\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS latitude,
  source_url
FROM (
  SELECT
    url AS source_url,
    UNNEST(
      regexp_extract_all(content, '<result>[\\s\\S]*?</result>', 0),
      recursive := true
